critical_code_review_comments: routes/subscriptions.py — submit_approval_request correctly branches on existing status: when status='approved', it preserves the approved status and returns {edited: true}; when status in {not_started, pending, rejected}, it submits as fresh pending. Confirmed via test_edit_count_after_approval_keeps_status_approved + test_edit_count_when_pending_resets_to_pending.

routes/subscriptions.py — GET /compliance with _compute_compliance helper correctly: (a) computes variance against approved_children_count if present else requested_children_count, (b) classifies into compliant/over_capacity/pending_review/rejected/no_request, (c) summary counts match per-row tallies, (d) gracefully handles schools with no actual_active_students query (returns 0). Filter param works for all 5 status values.
frontend CompliancePage.jsx — clean read-only design, no Approve/Reject/Edit affordances; KPIs reflect summary; filter pill counters use summary[k]; loading state handled.

frontend SchoolSubscription.jsx — ApprovedEditPanel toggles cleanly between display + edit modes; preserves approved status via the same POST /approval-request endpoint (server-side decision), so the UI doesn't need to special-case anything. Note count was successfully edited from 500 -> 777 with status remaining approved.
